Generator of storage/testdata/ring-format-1/: a ring directory written by the build at
6827a7b3a (next, 2026-11-02), before the FORMAT marker, record format 2 and dedupe format 3
existed. It was dropped into cluster/wire/ as zz_ringformat1_generator_test.go and run once
with RING_FORMAT1_FIXTURE_OUT set, from hoardDB/:

    RING_FORMAT1_FIXTURE_OUT=$PWD/storage/testdata/ring-format-1 go test ./cluster/wire -run TestZZGenerateRingFormat1Fixture -count=1 -v

The run reported five version-0x01 log records (seq 1..5, class 0x01: the two inserts a
bucket creation writes and the three user inserts) and the matching format-0x02 dedupe
entries. raft/ and incarnation were not copied; there is no FORMAT file. badger/ is 1,049,665
bytes (the 1 MiB DISCARD file is zeros), under the 2 MiB bound, so the whole directory is
checked in.

----8<---- the throwaway test ----8<----

package wire

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/hoarddb/hoarddb-bson/bson"

	"hoardDB/storage"
)

// Throwaway: generates the ring-format-1 fixture from the base tree (6827a7b3a), before the
// FORMAT marker, record format 2 and dedupe format 3 exist. It opens a ring node on a temp
// directory, writes three operations (three format-0x02 dedupe entries in Badger and three
// version-0x01 records in the log), closes it, and copies out badger/ and wal/ only.
//
//	RING_FORMAT1_FIXTURE_OUT=/abs/path/storage/testdata/ring-format-1 go test ./cluster/wire -run TestZZGenerateRingFormat1Fixture -count=1
func TestZZGenerateRingFormat1Fixture(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("RING_FORMAT1_FIXTURE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("RING_FORMAT1_FIXTURE_OUT not set")
	}
	dir := t.TempDir()
	ctx := context.Background()
	node, err := OpenNode(ctx, NodeConfig{Dir: dir})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	u30iSchema(t, node)
	for i, name := range []string{"Ada", "Grace", "Linus"} {
		request := [16]byte{0xF1, byte(i + 1)}
		if _, err := node.Insert(ctx, u30iDB, "User", bson.D{{Key: "_id_", Value: name}, {Key: "Name", Value: name}, {Key: "Age", Value: int32(30 + i)}, {Key: "City", Value: "Oslo"}}, WithRequestID(request)); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("insert %s: %v", name, err)
		}
	}
	entries, err := node.wal.ReadFrom(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("log holds %d entries", len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		t.Logf("seq %d op %#02x version %#02x", entry.Seq, entry.Op, entry.Data[0])
	}
	if err := node.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, part := range []string{"badger", "wal"} {
		if err := copyTree(filepath.Join(dir, part), filepath.Join(out, part)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	_ = storage.NSDedupe
}

func copyTree(src, dst string) error {
	return filepath.WalkDir(src, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(src, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if d.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0o755)
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return os.WriteFile(target, raw, 0o644)
	})
}
